_comment: Promoted at GATE S (2026-09-24) from contracts/_archive/no-vendor-production-posture/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md. PAUSED-MODE contract: run ONLY against a backend booted with MARKET_DATA_MODE=paused (no MASSIVE_API_KEY needed). Every vendor-backed route answers 503 {detail:"Market data is paused.",code:"market_data_paused"}; health and scan report market_data. NOT part of the nightly production set (conformance.yml names its specs explicitly) - production mode can be flipped back to live. Since SEC-1 (2026-10-26) the two scan reads are signed-in only, so they are marked auth and this spec runs with --auth-signup (or --auth-cookie). Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the endpoints marked _owner_gate read licence-derived data and answer the owner's account alone, so they are marked auth and this spec runs with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session. A --auth-signup user is not an owner and gets 403 owner_only; the refusals are asserted in public-surface.json (signed out) and auth-gated.json (signed in, not the owner).

endpoints._owner_gate: Owner gate (2026-10-26): owner only, since this read carries data computed from the licensed options feed. Run with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session; signed out is 403 auth_required (public-surface.json) and a signed-up non-owner is 403 owner_only (auth-gated.json).
